title.zh: SMBC Nikko and Nethermind Plan Compliance Hooks for Uniswap Pools
title.en: SMBC Nikko and Nethermind Plan Compliance Hooks for Uniswap Pools

current_state.zh: SMBC Nikko, Nethermind, Uniswap Labs, Base and the Nyx Foundation have signed an MOU to develop compliance hooks for Uniswap pools as part of a Japan-focused DeFi gateway targeted for completion by mid-2027.
current_state.en: SMBC Nikko, Nethermind, Uniswap Labs, Base and the Nyx Foundation have signed an MOU to develop compliance hooks for Uniswap pools as part of a Japan-focused DeFi gateway targeted for completion by mid-2027.
